HEADER: Init +12; Senses Detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, detect law, low-light vision; Perception +17
DEFENSE: AC 29, touch 24, flat-footed 15 (+5 deflection, +8 dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural)
OFFENSE: Melee +1 Longsword +17 (1d8+1/19-20) or Touch +16 (1d4 Cha damage)
Special Attacks Lethe Arrow, Zephyr Arrow
Special Abilities Angel Whisper, Summer Breeze, White Wind
At will (DC 15) - Dancing Lights, Daze, Holy Orb, Ghost Sound
1st (DC 16) - Color Spray, Cure, Heal, Light (DC 17), Mage Armor, Silent Image
2nd (DC 17) - Blur, Cure II, Healara, Jitterbugs, Light II (DC 18), Magic Mouth
3rd (DC 18) - Cura, Cure III, Dispel, Displacement, Light III (DC 19), Lightra (DC 19)
4th (DC 19) - Cure IV, Holy (DC 20), Light IV (DC 20), Silencega
STATISTICS: Str 10, Dex 26, Con 14, Int 16, Wis 20, Cha 21
Feats Alertness, Combat Casting, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Light Focus, Persuasive, Quicken Spell (Mage Armor), Spell Focus (enchantment), Weapon Finesse

Skills Acrobatics +16, Bluff +15, Diplomacy +25, Escape Artist +17, Fly +19, Knowledge (arcana) +12, Knowledge (nature) +14, Perception +17, Sense Motive +18, Spellcraft +6, Stealth +17, Use Magic Device +15
SQ change shape (any female humanoid), unearthly grace
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Angel Whisper (su) 1/day, a sidhe heals herself or an ally by 3d6+12 points of damage and bestows Reraise status for 1d6 rounds upon their ally or self. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 7th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 29).
Charmed Life (ex) A sidhe gains a +4 luck bonus on all saves against figment-based illusions and compulsion effects.

Lethe Arrow (su) 3/day, a sidhe shoots out a blue arrow towards her opponent within 60 ft. The sidhe must make a ranged touch attack (+16), if it hits, the attack deals 8d6 points of wind damage and inflicts Silence status effect (Will save DC 23 to negate) for 1d2 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 25).

Summer Breeze (su) 3/day, a sidhe surrounds herself in a yellowish-orange breeze that functions like Esuna. If there is no bad status effect to remove or fails to remove the status effect, then the caster gains Fast Healing 5 for 3 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 23).
Unearthly Grace (su) A sidhe adds her Charisma modifier as a racial bonus on all her saving throws and as a deflection bonus to her AC.

White Wind (su) 3/day a sidhe can emit a gust of white wind that heals allies other than itself within 20 feet for an amount equal to the sidhe's current hit points in damage. The healing received per creature is capped at 10 per hit die attained for the caster (ex: 7 hit dice would mean a cap of 70 healing for each creature). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 23).

Zephyr Arrow (su) A sidhe shoots out a green arrow towards her opponent within 60 ft. The sidhe must makes a ranged touch attack (+16), if it hits, the attack deals 3d6 points of wind damage and knocks her opponent back 10 ft. (Fortitude save DC 23 to negate). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 2nd level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 19).

curation.summary: Sidhe is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 59 generated item(s) across 9 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
